Taunt (Japanese: ちょうはつ Taunt) is a non-damaging Dark-type move introduced in Generation III.

It is:

  • TM12 from Generation III to Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, and in Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl.
  • TM02 in Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!.
  • TR37 in Pokémon Sword and Shield.
  • TM087 in Generation IX.

Effect

Generation III

Taunt makes the afflicted Pokémon unable to use status moves. The effect lasts two turns or until the subject is switched out. Unlike most status moves, Taunt will affect a target with a substitute. On the turn that Taunt is used, if the Pokémon using Taunt goes before the target and the target selected a status move that turn, the target's move will fail. If a Pokémon that only knows status moves is taunted, or is taunted after using a status move and holding a Choice item, then it will be forced to use Struggle.

Taunt can be used as the first move of a Pokémon Contest combination, causing Counter, Detect, and Mirror Coat to score double the normal appeal if used in the next turn.

Generation IV

The duration of Taunt is now between three and five turns.

Taunt can now be copied by Mirror Move.

Generation V

The duration of Taunt is now three turns if the user acts before the target, or four turns if the target acted before the user.

Taunt can now be reflected with Magic Coat and no longer affects Me First.

Generation VI onwards

Pokémon with Oblivious or under the effect of Aroma Veil cannot become taunted.

Taunt can also be used as part of a Contest Spectacular combination, causing certain moves (Counter, Destiny Bond, Grudge, King's Shield, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, and Spite) to give an extra three appeal points if used in the next turn.

Taunt will not prevent the target from using a status Z-Move, but will prevent a Dynamax target from using Max Guard.

If powered up by a Darkinium Z into Z-Taunt, the user's Attack rises one stage.

Other effects

Clobbopus that know this move will evolve into Grapploct when leveled up.

In other games

Pokémon Mystery Dungeon series

In Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team, Taunt is a move with 20PP and 100% accuracy. It targets enemy, inflicting Taunted status condition. A Taunted Pokémon, as in the main series games, cannot use status moves; they also cannot use Seeds or Wonder Orbs. This move is affected by the Taunted status condition as well.

In Explorers of Time, Darkness and Sky, the move can now be reflected with Magic Coat.

While the list for most follows the main series, there are some differences, mostly due to certain attacking moves becoming status moves in these games. Moves that are marked with ✓ cannot be used while Taunted.

Games Description
MDRB Inflicts the Taunted status on the targeted Pokémon.
MDTDS Afflicts the targeted enemy with a Taunted status condition, which restricts a Pokémon to using only moves that inflict damage.
BSL てきポケモンを ちょうはつじょうたいにかえる ちょうはつされた ポケモンは ダメージを あたえるわざしか だせなくなる
MDGtI It causes the Taunted status condition to an enemy. The taunted Pokémon can't use status moves. (The Pokémon can use attack moves.)
SMD It makes an enemy taunted. The taunted Pokémon can't use status moves. The Pokémon can use attack moves, however.
